title: Observed Level 1 audio events batch 1

0x4a7bc0.name: _lock
0x4a7bc0.reason: C runtime lock: enters an operating-system critical section; the game is single-threaded here

0x4a7c40.name: _unlock
0x4a7c40.reason: C runtime unlock: leaves an operating-system critical section

0x4f63ec.name: operator new
0x4f63ec.reason: the C runtime heap ends in operating-system calls

0x4b45f0.name: playAudio
0x4b45f0.reason: Physical audio voice acquisition and DirectSound playback cannot run without the native audio device provider.

0x4b8960.name: waitMilliseconds
0x4b8960.reason: Physical multimedia-clock busy wait requires real timeGetTime progress and is supplied by the native timing provider.

0x4bc670.name: createRenderSurface
0x4bc670.reason: DirectDraw surface construction reaches device COM methods and platform surface ownership; cases supply the native rendering service result.

0x4b9c50.name: blitRenderSurface
0x4b9c50.reason: Physical DirectDraw Blt and lost-surface recovery require a rendering device.

0x4bc4f0.name: releaseRenderSurface
0x4bc4f0.reason: Platform surface-list removal and DirectDraw object destruction belong to the rendering provider.

0x4ec050.name: createRenderFader
0x4ec050.reason: CFaderMgr creates physical rendering effects over device surfaces; cases inspect the original-initialized descriptor and supply renderer handles.

0x4ec9c0.name: runRenderFader
0x4ec9c0.reason: Timed rendering effect execution uses GetTickCount and device presentation; the native renderer supplies the effect service.

0x4ec600.name: releaseRenderFader
0x4ec600.reason: CFaderMgr removes and destroys provider-owned rendering effects; cases supply that physical rendering lifecycle.

0x5469e4.name: KERNEL32.dll!lstrlenA
0x5469e4.reason: Windows string-length import reachable from original CString assignment requires an import fixture.

0x5469e8.name: KERNEL32.dll!InterlockedDecrement
